llms.body:
# Harbour Demo Plumbing

Fictional assessment fixture. Services in Sydney; contact the demo office for details.

description: Site check: Robots rules / site-wide Disallow

data.checked: Parsed 4 groups; root and representative public path allowed for *, Googlebot and Bingbot.
data.why: Broad rules can prevent search engines crawling public pages.
data.recommendation: Confirm intended visibility, remove unintended broad Disallow rules, then retest.

description: Site check: AI crawler rules by purpose

data.checked: Search/user crawlers blocked on sampled paths: ChatGPT-User
data.why: Search and user-initiated access differ from training consent; robots rules alone do not establish crawler access or visibility.
data.recommendation: Review search/user restrictions with the customer; retain intentional training choices. User-initiated agents may not obey robots rules; verify the journey manually.

data.checked: No noindex in 7 crawl indexing records. Meta directives inspected where available; individual HTTP-header attribution may be unavailable outside the homepage.
data.why: Unintended noindex on home or key pages prevents those pages appearing in search.
data.recommendation: Confirm intended indexing per URL; inspect response headers on unsampled pages. Remove noindex only on pages intended for search.

data.checked: Compared 7 sitemap URLs with existing crawl results: 0 with observed issues, 0 uncrawled/unavailable (NOT ASSESSED).
data.why: Sitemaps should list final, successful, indexable URLs; uncrawled URLs are unknown.
data.recommendation: Replace redirects/non-200/noindex URLs; manually validate uncrawled entries. Use absolute HTTP(S) sitemap URLs in production.

data.checked: 3 declarations; 0 need review; 0 targets NOT ASSESSED. http://127.0.0.1:18765/ -> http://127.0.0.1:18765/: HTTP 200 ; http://127.0.0.1:18765/service/a/ -> http://127.0.0.1:18765/service/a/: HTTP 200 ; http://127.0.0.1:18765/service/b/ -> http://127.0.0.1:18765/service/b/: HTTP 200
data.why: Canonical hints should consistently identify accessible, indexable preferred pages.
data.recommendation: Review conflicting targets; use final indexable URLs. Manually verify uncrawled targets.

description: Site check: Duplicates, headings / internal links

data.checked: Duplicate title groups: 1; duplicate description groups: 1; heading issues: 1; broken internal links: 2; unavailable links: 0; internal redirects: 2. Inbound links: NOT ASSESSED (incomplete sampled link graph).
data.why: Distinct metadata, logical headings and direct internal links improve navigation and help crawlers interpret pages.
data.recommendation: Use distinct titles/descriptions, fix heading jumps and broken links, link directly to final targets. Retry unavailable links before classifying them. Verify possible orphan pages with a complete link graph.

data.checked: Validated 1 supported JSON-LD nodes. No invalid supported properties found.  4 applicable-property suggestions; absence is not a failure.
data.why: Consistent structured data clarifies entities; it does not guarantee rich results.
data.recommendation: Fix invalid JSON-LD and required properties; review applicable recommended properties with Google's Rich Results Test. Organization has no required properties.

data.checked: Compared 2 location-like URLs with >=80 sampled words using 5-word shingle Jaccard >=0.8: 1 similar pairs. Heuristic only; shared navigation and truncated text can influence similarity.
data.why: Near-duplicate location pages may warrant review for doorway-page risk; this is never a confirmed doorway-page finding.
data.recommendation: Manually compare unique local value and remove shared boilerplate before deciding whether to improve or consolidate pages.

description: Site check: Core Web Vitals (field p75)

data.checked: No usable CrUX/PSI p75 field data. Lighthouse lab scores are not CWV.
data.why: Field LCP, INP and CLS describe real-user experience; origin and URL scopes differ.
data.recommendation: Investigate non-good field metrics and verify all three at p75. Good: LCP <=2500 ms, INP <=200 ms, CLS <=0.1. Poor: LCP >4000 ms, INP >500 ms, CLS >0.25. Missing field data requires manual verification; preserve separate lab findings.

description: Site check: Booking / CRM / chat tools

data.checked: Detected markup signals: Calendly. Script/link/iframe URLs and recognised inline API calls; prose excluded. Iframes outside the normal-UA homepage probe may be unavailable.
data.why: Public integration signals help identify systems to discuss; they do not prove account existence, ownership or working integration.
data.recommendation: Confirm customer-owned systems and test authorised journeys before proposing changes.

description: Site check: Conversion pathways / forms NOT TESTED

data.checked: 6 rendered pages inspected for forms, booking links, tel/mailto, CTA wording, trust signals and case-study/portfolio/team/about links. Above-the-fold placement NOT ASSESSED where positions are unavailable. Form submissions: NOT TESTED. Trust claims and journey outcomes are unverified.
data.why: Visible enquiry options help plan journey validation; their presence does not prove forms, booking, lead delivery or conversion performance work.
data.recommendation: Review missing paths and CTA prominence manually; arrange an authorised safe journey test with the customer. No submissions were made.
